name.description: The customer slug, which names the folder

modules.description: The module ids this customer's image carries

onboardingMode.description: How people first reach the deployment

localAccounts.description: Whether the deployment allows local accounts

genieStudioUrl.description: The genie-studio deployment's origin, for example https://studio.example.com; omit when the customer does not run genie-studio

firstAdministrators.description: Email addresses of the first administrators, at least one

productName.description: What the deployment is called in its own branding

defaultLocale.description: The deployment's locale, for example en

defaultTimeZone.description: The deployment's time zone, for example Europe/Berlin
